name: Introduction to Environmental Science
summary: An on-ramp to how natural systems work and how people use, pollute and protect them: ecosystems, resources, pollution and sustainability.

topics.name: Environmental science as an interdisciplinary field; systems thinking
Matter and energy flow in ecosystems; trophic levels
Population growth: ecological and human demography
Biogeochemical cycles at a glance: carbon, nitrogen, phosphorus and water
Land use, agriculture, forests and food production
Energy: fossil fuels, nuclear and renewables
Global climate change: causes, evidence and consequences
Environmental ethics, policy and the idea of sustainability
